title: Pocket Money
paragraphs: “Ah, Father may already know this, but I’ve heard that weapons and the like are stamped with the maker’s mark, and there are merchants who check for it when they’re sold.”
“Is that so? So that means—”
“Well… when I pointed it out to Trash during the loop, it was swept under the rug using his influence.”
“…I figured as much.”
I had a feeling you’d say that, Father, so I’m getting ahead of you. Those guys only ever think about pointless things, after all.
“So, does that mean we can’t sell anything without a maker’s mark?”
“Not at all. This is Zeltoble, after all. With business acumen like yours, Father, there’s no way you’d ever be lowballed.”
“Hey, stop giving me that ‘you know me inside and out’ look.”
Not at all. There’s no way someone like me could ever fathom the cosmic depths of Father’s thoughts. After all, I’m just imitating what I’ve seen while repeating the loop.
“So, Father, are you going to sell it to a dealer?”
“Ah. Motoyasu, what are you planning to do?”
“I’m going to sleep in the hut with Filo-tan.”
“Gua!? Gua-gua-gua!”
Filo-tan, who had been sitting quietly in the shed, stood up, went over to Father, and nipped at his collar with her beak. What’s going on here?
“Gwa! Gwa-gwa!”
Filo-tan is chirping something at Father and shaking her head.
“……She looks like she really hates this.”
“Why is that!? I just want to smell Filo-tan.”
“So that’s what you were trying to do… Either way, don’t sleep here. Filo can’t rest.”
“Gua! Gua-gua!”

Filo-chan is clinging to Father with all her might. Ugh… I’ve been looking forward to this ever since the loop restarted, but it didn’t quite work out. Still, there’s bound to be another chance. Right now is the time to build trust, after all. Just as I was thinking that, Father scolded Filo-chan, looking annoyed.
“Ugh, stop clinging to me! And stop acting so clingy!”
“Guaa!”
“Oh, come on… It’s just like yesterday!”
Father is grumbling about something. What on earth happened between him and Filo-tan yesterday!? As far as my research and memory go, he was just soothing a lonely Filo-tan until she fell asleep.
“Anyway, Motoyasu, you’re forbidden from sleeping in the same hut as Filo.”
“Ah, that’s too harsh!”
Even though it’s a rare chance with Filo-tan, if it’s Father’s order, I guess I have no choice. I’ll just have to make do with the scent of the feather I picked up while hunting.
“Raphtalia’s resting at the inn… Well, I guess there’s no helping it. Let’s go sell some stuff.”
“Understood.”
“Guh.”

And so, leaving my older sister asleep at the inn, we headed to the shops in Zeltoble at night. Father went around to a few shops that were open even at night, having me check the prices of the items and chatting with the merchants about something or other. Eventually, he got several shops to buy the goods from us.
“You’re going to buy such beautiful, like-new items at that price? Forget it… I’ll just go sell them at that other shop.”
Just as Father was about to cut off the negotiation with an air of utter exasperation, the merchant reached out, looking as if he didn’t want to let us go.
“W-wait! You wouldn’t be…”
“…Yeah, that’s exactly what I mean.”
This exchange has already happened twice now. It seems there are rival factions—or rather, competitors—even among the shops in Zeltoble. He pretended he was going to sell to one of them.

That’s Father’s business tactic. While Father usually is gentle, he used to hold back a bit, but he’s been pulling this move quite frequently lately. I suppose this difference is due to the fact that I wasn’t able to help him back then.
“G-… Fine. I’ll throw in 15 silver coins on top. That’s the limit.”
“Hmm… Then give me 5 silver coins and… those monster hides sitting unsold over there. They’re just surplus anyway, right?”
“…Sigh. You’re quite the troublesome guy, aren’t you? Fine.”
The merchant gave a wry smile.
“You seemed to be trying to take advantage of me, so I just didn’t hold back either.”
“So it’s my fault, huh? Damn it… If you come back, I’ll throw in a little something extra.”

They’re shaking hands or something. Seriously, Father sure does make friends with merchants quickly. So, Father casually stashed the hides he’d wrested from the merchant into his shield. Of course, he offered some to me too, but since I already had that material, I declined.
“Hmm, that turned into a decent sum of money.”
“Gua!”

Filo-chan begged Father to buy her some fruit. I bought the same thing and we ate them as a pair. Partway through, Filo-chan stopped eating and looked at me. When Filo-chan tried to leave some uneaten, I went to take it, but she ate it all and then hid behind Father.
Hmm, I feel like there’s some distance between us… but I’m probably just imagining things! Since Filo-chan is like this even in this peaceful world, she’s just being shy.
“We’ve got plenty of gear and supplies… Is there really much point in making money? It seems like we just need the funds for Class Up… No, better safe than sorry…”
Father seems to be mulling over various things. In that case, I’ll go ahead and make a request. I’m sure he’ll give it some thought.
“I’d like more Filolial-sama!”
“Sigh… You still want more even though you have Filo?”
“Filo-tan is my girlfriend, and the Filolial-sama are my children.”
“Is that a declaration that you’re going to get up to all sorts of things with Filo?”
“Gwa!?”
Filo-chan lets out a sort of trembling sound and backs away from me.
“That’s not it! I, Motoyasu, have a purely platonic relationship with Filo-chan. I’ll refrain from any lewd behavior until true peace comes to the world.”
“You’re not saying you won’t do it, though…”
Hahaha! That’s the promise I made with Filo-tan, after all.
“So, does that mean you want to marry Filolial?”
“That’s right! Ultimately, I want to be accepted by my future Father and have a grand wedding ceremony.”
“Either way, we’ll have to wait until we see if Filo grows up the way you say she will.”
Oh, Father has put me on hold. Well then, let’s wait until I’ve had a good look at the real Filo-chan herself. I, Motoyasu, can certainly wait.
“Guaaaah…”
“Filo, you might not like this, but you’ll have to put up with it.”
“So, Father, are you going to look for my Older Sister’s Older Sister?”
“…No, a lot has happened tonight and I’m exhausted. I’d like to find her for Raphtalia’s sake, but I’m worried about Raphtalia herself. I’m going to head home and get some rest.”
“Understood! Then, let’s head back!”

So, with that, we wrapped up our activities for the day, headed back to the inn, and got some rest. Oh, and I hear Father stayed up with Big Sister—who had undergone Recovery—until Filo-tan fell asleep. I would have liked to join them, but Father-in-law told me an exciting story—that Filo-chan was too wary of me to fall asleep—so I had no choice but to sleep in a separate room. I gathered Filo-chan’s shed feathers by my pillow and drifted off to sleep, half-asleep, half-awake.
The next day.
“I thought she’d gotten bigger by last night, but…”
“Yeah… I guess so.”
“Gaaah!”
Although Filo-tan had already started growing quite a bit by last night, it seems Father and the others really realized the extent of the change once it got light out.
“This is Filo-tan’s growth! She’ll be back to her familiar self in just a little while.”
“Is she still going to change?”
“Guh… Kue!”
Oh, it seems she’s already starting to change again. Filo-tan’s appearance is gradually shifting back to the Filo-tan we all remember.
“At this rate, won’t she be able to take on her angelic form by snack time?”
“Ah… right. I’d really rather she didn’t.”
“I agree. By the way, what should we do today?”
“Yesterday we leveled up Raphtalia and the others, right? Today I want to level up myself.”
“So I’ll be left in charge, then?”
If we’re splitting up, there’s plenty I’d like to do. This is Zeltoble—there are countless things to do here. Above all, since I have the Portal Skills, I can go anywhere in the world.
“I suppose so. Still, don’t cause any unnecessary trouble, okay? We’ve managed to lie low this far—there’s no point in drawing attention to ourselves every time.”
“Got it!”
I don’t need to be told twice—I won’t cause any unnecessary trouble. It was everyone else who was causing a commotion up until now—I wasn’t the cause. I’d hate for you to get that wrong.
“I don’t think he gets it.”
“What a coincidence. I think so too.”

Father is nodding as if he and Big Sister have some kind of unspoken understanding. That’s what it means to be teammates, isn’t it? I can’t wait to have a relationship like that with Filo-chan and Father.
“……Do you really think we can escape from Zeltoble, a city teeming with this many people?”
“Um…”
“Kue?”
“Filo-chan! Hang in there!”
Ah, even a cold-shouldering Filo-tan is wonderful! This is what true romance—and the art of seduction—is all about.
“Judging by how things went yesterday, I don’t think it’s possible. In the worst-case scenario, she might go around casting Magic powerful enough to wipe out everyone except us.”
“…That’s definitely a possibility.”
“What are you talking about?”
“Never mind. Anyway, Motoyasu, I’m leveling up today, so just do whatever you want as long as you don’t cause any unnecessary trouble.”
“Got it! Then I’ll go get some Filolial!”
I’ll try to find Yuki-chan, Kou, and even Kuu-chan, Marine, and Midori!
“Did you forget what we talked about yesterday? That would only happen if Filo went through the transformation you described.”
“All I have to do is make sure I don’t prepare for hatching.”
“Oh, for heaven’s sake… You listen to what I say, but you twist my instructions…”
“Just buying them without hatching them—that’s it, isn’t it? It’s like a kid who says they’re just watching but ends up sneaking a bite.”

“That’s a spot-on description. They’re the kind of person you’re afraid to take your eyes off because they’ll get up to something at the first chance they get… I don’t know, it’s making my stomach twist in knots.”
“Naofumi-sama, please take care of yourself.”
“I know. I’ll try not to worry about it too much.”
“Well then, Father, please give me some pocket money!”
I’ve handed over all my money to Father, so I don’t have any cash on hand. Well, if I don’t have any, I’ll just hunt down some nearby bandits or earn some money at the guild.
“All right. But make sure you keep quiet with that money.”
And so, today, Father ended up riding on Filo-tan’s back to go hunting. I received 20 silver coins from Father.
“That should be enough to keep you entertained for a while.”
It’s certainly enough for a bit of fun at the casino or the Colosseum. But what I really want is a Filolial.
I can’t even buy a single Filolial with this!

Well, I shouldn’t let it bother me. It would be presumptuous of me to complain about the money that Father generously gave me. So, I’ll just have to find a way to make up the difference somewhere else. Anyway, maybe I should offer Father some advice.
“We did quite a bit of hunting yesterday, after all. I think it’d be best to go somewhere different.”
“You’re right. There’s no point in getting duplicate materials.”
“I recommend the forest next to the mountain where we hunted yesterday. Don’t you think the monsters we failed to defeat yesterday might be gathering around there?”
“We’re not out to slaughter them all, are we?”
“There might be territorial disputes going on, you know. That’s something I learned from Filolial.”
I’m human by race, but I’m striving to emulate Filolial’s way of life. That’s why I exchange information with her on a daily basis.
“Oh, I see. Well, I’ll be off then.”
“I’ll come pick you up when it’s time!”
“How are you going to… No, never mind. I don’t want to know.”

And with that, Father and the others rode off on Filo-tan’s back. Well then, I’m off to look for Filolial’s egg too! But I don’t have enough money for that. Let’s see if there are any good jobs at the Zeltoble Adventurers’ Guild.

Are there any quick-cash quests? I’ll pop into the Adventurers’ Guild—skipping through parts here and there—and pick out a suitable quest. The problem is that, as Father instructed, I have to earn money without causing too much of a fuss, don’t I?

Would it be okay to storm a guild of Darkness and take on a betting match? But that’s a hassle in its own right—you end up waiting around. I still have plenty of time before I have to go pick up Father and the others, but if I’m taking on quests, the time will fly by in a flash!

Hmm… Even if I were to hunt bounties, their locations are too vague. Would it be faster to hunt bandits along the trade routes merchants frequently use? Gathering materials or slaying monsters would be good options, too.
The bustling Zeltoble Adventurers’ Guild seems to be teeming with countless quests. The board where quests are posted gets updated regularly.

…It’s an absolute hassle that you need credibility or reputation just to accept a quest. Because of Zeltoble’s unique rules, I couldn’t take on any of the lucrative quests. Since I’m hiding my identity as a Hero, I have to start from the very bottom.

What a hassle. It would probably be faster to storm a suitable colosseum and earn some fame, but I don’t have time for that right now. I have no choice but to play it safe: I’ll use a portal to travel to the countryside, hunt down monsters, and sell the materials for cash.
